Which ones do we need?"},{"id":"M1:T10","text":"So the ETCS trainborne equipment has to be able to supervise these operational states,"},{"id":"M1:T11","text":"Go ahead."},{"id":"M1:T12","text":"Full Supervision, Partial Supervision, Staff Responsible, On Sight, Unfitted Line, Train Trip, Post Trip, National operation, so STM, then Tandem, Multiple, Shunting, Stand By, and Reversing operation."},{"id":"M1:T13","text":"Yeah, that covers what we use."},{"id":"M1:T14","text":"And any transition that happens while the train is moving should, in principle, happen automatically."},{"id":"M1:T15","text":"Okay."},{"id":"M1:T16","text":"Now, if the transition has to be acknowledged,"},{"id":"M1:T17","text":"Right."},{"id":"M1:T18","text":"and the driver doesn't acknowledge it the way they're supposed to,"},{"id":"M1:T19","text":"Mm-hm."},{"id":"M1:T20","text":"then ETCS has to trigger a brake application."}]}
